ventro

Show a command line tool’s own help inside R documentation, generated when the help page is viewed. Users see the help for the version installed on their machine.

roxygen2 can already run code at render time. ventro handles what that code has to get right:

  • Escaping. {, }, % and \ in help text are escaped so the Rd stays valid.
  • Never erroring. A missing tool, failing locator or empty output renders a short “not available” notice. R CMD check and the PDF manual on machines without the tool are unaffected. A tool that hangs is stopped after 5 seconds, and any output so far is shown as cut off.
  • Literal arguments. Arguments reach the tool exactly as written, with no shell expansion of $, * or ;.
  • Clean output. ANSI colour codes, terminal bold/underline and invalid encodings are stripped.
  • Tools not on PATH. A locator function can find the tool and set environment variables such as FREESURFER_HOME.

Usage

With roxygen2 8.0.0 or later and markdown enabled, use inline Rd code:

#' Convert MRI volumes
#'
#' @section Command line help:
#' `Rd ventro::cli_help_rd("mri_convert", "--help")`
#' @importFrom ventro cli_help_rd
#' @export
mri_convert <- function(...) { ... }

Add ventro to Imports. The @importFrom only needs to appear once in the package; it stops R CMD check from noting that ventro is imported but not used.

Tools not on PATH

locate is a function, or its name as "pkg::fun", that runs at render time. It takes the command name and returns a path, a list(path = , env = ), or NULL if the tool can’t be found:

find_tool <- function(command) {
  home <- Sys.getenv("FREESURFER_HOME")
  if (!nzchar(home)) return(NULL)
  list(
    path = file.path(home, "bin", command),
    env = c(FREESURFER_HOME = home)
  )
}
#' `Rd ventro::cli_help_rd("mri_convert", "--help", locate = "mypkg::find_tool")`

Reuse the logic your wrapper functions use, so help pages and function calls agree on which installation they see.

Debugging

Every failure shows the same notice. To see why, set the option and open the help page again:

options(ventro.debug = TRUE)
?mri_convert

The notice then includes the reason, such as an error from the locator.

When the help is generated

In the dynamic help that R and RStudio use by default, the tool runs each time the page is opened. Static HTML help, installed with R CMD INSTALL --html, and the PDF manual are generated once, so they show the tool as it was on the machine that installed the package or built the manual.

The @clihelp tag

An optional roxygen2 tag that writes the section and the import for you, and also works on roxygen2 versions before 8.0.0. Enable it in DESCRIPTION:

Imports: ventro
Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE, packages = "ventro")
#' @clihelp mri_convert --help

This adds a section titled Command line help: mri_convert --help. Arguments are split on whitespace, so a single argument can’t contain a space; use inline Rd code for those. Lines after the command replace the title, as plain text:

#' @clihelp mri_convert --help
#'   Options for mri_convert

Package-wide defaults go in DESCRIPTION:

Config/ventro/title: Options for \code{{command}}
Config/ventro/locate: mypkg::find_tool

command is replaced with the command and its arguments. This title is Rd markup, so escape %, {, } and \ with a backslash.
